name: week
title: The grooming week
subtitle: Private read-only working record. Times are UTC.

sections.title: Upcoming appointments
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM v_schedule WHERE starts_at>=current_date AND starts_at<current_date+7 ORDER BY starts_at

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM v_attention ORDER BY due_on

name: rebooking
title: Rebooking and van planning
subtitle: Private read-only working record. Times are UTC.

sections.title: Due back
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM v_rebooking ORDER BY due_on

sections.title: Waiting pets
sections.sql: SELECT p.name AS pet,c.name AS client,c.suburb,w.wanted_on,w.notes FROM waitlist w JOIN pets p ON p.id=w.pet_id JOIN clients c ON c.id=p.client_id WHERE w.status='open'

name: money
title: Grooming balances
subtitle: Private read-only working record. Times are UTC.

sections.title: Unpaid appointments
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM v_balances WHERE balance_cents>0 ORDER BY starts_at

name: care
title: Care records to review
subtitle: Private read-only working record. Times are UTC.

sections.title: Checks
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM v_compliance ORDER BY rule,pet
